{{Quote|Here it is! The Zargnor Clan! I knew those weapon parts sounded familiar! A clan of Ugnaughts got into the Great Hunt by building a bizarre war droid that they would ride inside of.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], speaking to the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]]|<ref name="TOR:TU">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Underdogs|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
The '''Zargnor Clan''' was a trio of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] ([[Gornik]], [[Slatblath]], and [[Ugmir]]) active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Hey, as possible rival bounty hunters go, these might not be too bad. Assuming they haven't finished their new war droid.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], speaking to the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]]|<ref name="TOR:TU" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Zargnor Clan had made it into the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] by utilizing their mechanical and engineering skills to build a [[Battle droid/Legends|war droid]] in which they could ride. The droid's [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] exploded during the entry melee of the competition, killing all participants except the Ugnaughts inside, thereby securing their spot in the competition.<ref name="TOR:TU" />

One of their targets was the [[Eidolon (assassin)|Eidolon]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. It was here they met the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]], who was hunting the same target, and thus was their rival on the planet.<ref name="TOR:TU" />

{{GameDS}}
The Hunter encountered the trio in their [[Ugnaught Clan Warehouse|warehouse]] before they had finished building the second version of their war droid, and killed them.<ref name="TOR:TU" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The player has the option of either convincing the Ugnaughts not to fight, and thus sparing them, or beating them in combat and then letting them flee.<ref name="TOR:TU" />
